image.prompt:
Product photograph of one isolated object, shot from a HIGH THREE-QUARTER ANGLE: the camera is well above the object and tilted down about 30 degrees, so the top of the object is clearly visible along with its front and one side. Not a straight-on elevation.

The object: Litter bin made from three used car tyres stacked and bolted together, the top tyre painted a bright colour with a hand-painted Thai character, a black plastic bag liner folded over the top rim Materials: worn black rubber with grey dust in the tread grooves, flaking bright red and yellow paint on the top tyre, glossy black bin liner.

Form: build the object from a few simple, chunky, closed volumes. Prefer solid panels over lattice, mesh, grilles or perforated screens; keep any openings few, large and clearly separated. No thin spindly protrusions, no wires, no chains, no fringes, no lace, no fine filigree, no dense repeated slots or cut-outs. Keep the silhouette simple and readable from every side. Keep the object's SHAPE simple; richness must come from the surface finish, wear and materials rather than from intricate geometry. The object is still photoreal and highly detailed in its texture -- only its form is simple.

Framing: long-lens near-orthographic perspective, minimal foreshortening. The object is perfectly centred and occupies about 75% of the frame height, with clear empty margin on all four sides. The whole object is in frame; nothing is cropped.

Background: completely flat seamless neutral 50% grey (#808080). The object floats in empty space against an infinite seamless backdrop, photographed as a cut-out with nothing underneath it. There is no surface for it to rest on and nothing for it to cast a shadow onto. No floor, no ground plane, no horizon line, no cast shadow, no contact shadow, no reflection, no vignette, no gradient.

Lighting: flat even studio illumination from all sides, soft and shadowless, like a lightbox. No strong key light, no rim light, no coloured light, no specular blowout, no dramatic highlights. Colours must read as true albedo.

One object only, nothing else in frame. No people, no hands, no other props, no packaging, no text, no labels, no watermarks, no measurement annotations, no arrows, no borders, no drop shadow.

Photoreal, sharp focus edge to edge, clean and undamaged geometry, realistic materials and surface wear. Not stylised, not cartoon, not low-poly, not a 3D render preview, not a wireframe.

license.notice: Fully synthetic. No third-party scanned or scraped geometry.

review.critique: FINAL VERDICT. Overall visual fidelity 0.90. 1,856/2,000 triangles, 2/4 draw calls, 2/4 materials, 2/4 unique geometries, one 512 px canvas plus a 40 KB baked top.

featureReviews.evidence: Envelope 0.61 x 0.66 m; band table vs the proxy: mean |delta width| 0.0683, |delta depth| 0.0657, of which bands 1-3 and 5-6 at +0.04..+0.07 are the DECLARED 0.62 m tyre against the proxy's 0.58 (0.918 vs 0.858 w/h, within 0.01 once normalised by that ratio), bands 8-9 +0.08/+0.10 the full top tyre where the proxy fuses the bag into a closing dome, bands 4 and 7 (-0.065/-0.058) the seam grooves the proxy fills, band 0 +0.095 the rounded foot. Turntable ratios 1.000/1.001/0.982/1.000.
featureReviews.notes: The top bands depart from the proxy by instruction: the top tyre is a real tyre, not a bag dome.

featureReviews.evidence: 512 px two-strip tyre canvas on seamless around-by-up UVs: ~30 tread blocks with three grooves and staggered sipes per upper tyre, a grooved slick with shoulder sipes on the bottom tyre, bead rings, dust wash, scuffs and grain, bound as map and bump 0.035. Rubber shipped DARK (#282c36 / #2a2e38 / #372f28, luma 43-46 vs measured 48) with the silhouette gate held on chroma (sat >= 0.26 authored, ~0.20 rendered); holes 0.33/0.07/0.76/0.28% at 0/90/180/270 against the 1% ceiling.
featureReviews.notes: The cast is cool blue-black rather than the plate's neutral; the tread pattern is a generic block tread, not the plate's.

featureReviews.evidence: The plate's own top opening (695 x 401 px, x 165-860 / y 59-460) rectified to 512 px and baked as the top disc's map: red lid off-centre in the bag as in the plate, figure's head to -Z; disc r 0.248 at 0.655-0.66 m capping the top tyre, rim UVs pinned to a bag texel (no red ring); bag darks at 0.75 with a blue-black cast for the gate.
featureReviews.notes: Flat: the drape over the sidewall is in the image, not the geometry, as the brief asks.

name: Tyre Stack Bin
nameTh: ถังขยะยางรถยนต์
notes: The recycled-tyre bins outside village shops, schools and petrol stations, often painted with the word for rubbish. Three tyres bolted into one rigid stack: not breakable, no moving parts, one root pivot, no sockets. The bag liner is part of the top tyre's geometry, not a separate component. Cylinder collider for the round stack. Declared 0.62 m is a 15-inch car tyre's outer diameter and three tyre widths make the 0.66 m height.
